# activedirectory_computer (Data Source)

Look up an Active Directory computer account by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName. Errors if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single computer account by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName.
# Exactly one identity attribute must be set; the lookup errors if the
# computer is absent.
data "activedirectory_computer" "web01" {
  sam_account_name = "web01"
}

output "web01_dns_hostname" {
  value = data.activedirectory_computer.web01.dns_hostname
}

# Alternative lookups:
#
# data "activedirectory_computer" "web01" {
#   guid = "9f2c8f1e-1234-4000-8000-000000000004"
# }
#
# data "activedirectory_computer" "web01" {
#   dn = "CN=web01,OU=Servers,DC=corp,DC=local"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dn` (String) Look the object up by distinguished name.
- `guid` (String) Look the object up by objectGUID.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Look the object up by sAMAccountName.
- `sid` (String) Look the object up by security identifier.

### Read-Only

- `account_expiration_date` (String) Account expiry (RFC 3339), or "" if it never expires.
- `allowed_to_delegate_to` (Set of String) Constrained-delegation target service principal names (msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo).
- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `display_name` (String) The name shown in address lists.
- `dns_hostname` (String) The DNS host name (dNSHostName).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `kerberos_encryption_type` (Set of String) The Kerberos encryption types the account supports.
- `location` (String) Free-form location (location).
- `managed_by` (String) Distinguished name of the managing user or group (managedBy).
- `name` (String) The CN.
- `operating_system` (String) The operating system (operatingSystem). Read-only: the joined machine owns it.
- `operating_system_service_pack` (String) The operating-system service pack (operatingSystemServicePack). Read-only.
- `operating_system_version` (String) The operating-system version (operatingSystemVersion). Read-only.
- `principals_allowed_to_delegate_to_account` (Set of String) Resource-based constrained delegation (RBCD): the objectGUIDs of the principals allowed to delegate to this account.
- `service_principal_names` (Set of String) The account's service principal names.
- `trusted_for_delegation` (Boolean) Whether the account is trusted for unconstrained Kerberos delegation.
